# Module `env`

env - read and write the process environment.

Thin wrappers over the runtime's `__vyb_env_*` functions in
`runtime/vyb_runtime.c`. A lynx-style browser reads HTTP_PROXY / HOME / TERM
here instead of hard-coding them. `env_get` follows the engine-wide `T?` shape
(PROGRAMMERS_GUIDE §3.16): it returns `String?` -- absent when the variable is
unset, present holding its value (which may legitimately be empty). `env_set` /
`env_unset` return 0 on success (the change applies to this process and any
children it spawns).

Usage:
  import env
  home<String> = env_get("HOME") else "~"
  match (env_get("UNSET")) { v -> ..., ? -> ... }   // absent = unset
